_comment: Project-specific knobs for the sprint workflow. Every script and skill reads from here so nothing project-specific is hardcoded. Commands run from the repo root via bash.

qualityGates._comment: 'before' runs first (lint/format). 'test' runs only when the story has automated tests; {targets} is replaced by the story's testScope or the test files the agent touched. 'testAll' is the full suite, used by phase-review and as the PRD's last acceptance criterion. 'after' runs last (framework checks, migration checks, type checks).
before: echo 'TODO: set qualityGates.before in workflow/config.json (e.g. ruff check . / npm run lint)'
qualityGates.test: echo 'TODO: set qualityGates.test in workflow/config.json (e.g. pytest {targets} --tb=short / npx vitest run {targets})'
qualityGates.testAll: echo 'TODO: set qualityGates.testAll in workflow/config.json (e.g. pytest --tb=short / npm test)'

preFinishGates._comment: Commands sprint-finish.sh runs before merging to the base branch. Use for checks that per-story gates can miss (e.g. 'python manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run', 'npx prisma migrate diff --exit-code').

patternSkills._comment: Optional. Rows become a 'read this skill first' table in every per-story prompt. Point at your own .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md files.
